legal_citation: UK261 Art. 7(1)(c) & Wallentin-Hermann: £520 ($650) for >=240m delay (50% = $325 for 180-239m) when root cause is routine technical fault or crew timeout; Art. 9 hotel/meals always owed.
EU261 Art. 7 & Folkerts (C-11/11): Final destination arrival delay >=240m caused by controllable feeder delay triggers €600 ($650) plus Art. 9 meal care.
14 CFR Part 260 & Carrier Contract of Carriage Rule 24: Extraordinary weather carries $0 statutory cash delay payout, but carrier MUST rebook next-available same-cabin seat at $0 fare difference.
EU261 Art. 7(2) & Germanwings v. Henning (C-452/13): Arrival time is exact cabin door-open minute; 180-239m yields 50% (€300 / $325), <=179m yields $0.
US DOT Refund Rule & Montreal/Tariff Downgrade Provision: Commercial tail swap + involuntary Business-to-Economy downgrade requires 75% segment fare refund plus 100% ancillary fee reversal.
